errors.evidence: The description identifies the first category in the legend as "Енергия за отопление" (Heating energy). However, in the figure's legend, the first item, corresponding to the light blue color, is "Енергия за отопление", but the description lists it as if it corresponds to the bottom-most segment of the bars, which is dark blue and represents "Електроенергия" (Electricity).

The description lists "Електроенергия" (Electricity) as the last of the five components for the stacked bars. In the figure's legend, "Електроенергия" is the fifth component, corresponding to the dark blue color. However, this dark blue segment is the foundational (bottom) part of each bar, not the top-most or last in the stacking order, which is what the list order implies.
